name: SAIRU / BLACKSITE
intent: A typography-led portfolio with original SAIRU identity, factual work history, a technologies-only Toolkit, public repository archive and professional contact channels.
principles: Original vector identity and licensed open-source typography
Charcoal foundation with restrained mint interaction and coral signature
Decorative motion never blocks readable content

color.scope: .portfolio overrides in src/recon-identity.css; replaces previous yellow surfaces

lightCompatibilityOnly.note: Retained CSS compatibility; no current light-mode control in App.jsx. Contact remains dark.

usage.signal: Mint identity, interactions, focus and selected states
usage.coral: Limited signature detail and brief chromatic separation
usage.ratioBoundary: Color roles are documented; no unmeasured contrast ratios or certification asserted.

wordmark.accessibleText: Sairu. Software, sistemas e IA aplicada.

mono.usage: Commands, labels, dates, small data and captions

shape.radius: Square editorial surfaces; round only the small status dot

wordmarkEntry.behavior: Single left-to-right clip reveal with -12px initial translation

ticker.pause: Offscreen stationary wrapper or hidden document; preserve animation timeline. Static without IntersectionObserver.

motion.reducedMotion: OS preference disables decorative animations, transitions and smooth scrolling; wordmark stays readable and SignalField draws a stable frame.

signalField.reducedMotion: Render a stable frame; no continuous loop
signalField.fallback: Static CSS background for unavailable WebGL, shader setup failure or later context loss
signalField.contextLoss: Cancel pending frame, mark renderer fallback and stop drawing until unmount
signalField.chunkFailure: Local React error boundary replaces the decorative scene with a static field; content and links remain mounted.

ambient.reducedMotion: No drift animation; will-change reset to auto

components.hero: Original full-width geometric SAIRU wordmark, technical margin, segmented dark green/oxblood type strip and asymmetric lower composition.
components.navigation: Desktop anchors and mobile toggle with aria-expanded. Escape closes an open menu and restores focus to its trigger.
components.biography: Dark green editorial section preserving real paid software roles and education dates.
components.terminal: Local deterministic command exploration with labeled input, polite live log and truthful navigation/contact output.

contact.heading: O próximo passo é uma conversa.
contact.layout: Portuguese editorial copy and two direct channels over a shaded original contour field

components.projectSurface: PublicArchive repository inventory with snapshot metadata and curated descriptions. Datashard showcase and suggested lab prototypes are not mounted.
components.edgeRegistration: Fixed decorative edge code. Explicit override prevents the prior relative-positioning flow defect that added about 296px.
components.toolkit: Technologies and related concepts only, grouped into software, embedded systems and electromechanics/control. Buttons expose aria-pressed/aria-controls and update a polite atomic detail region.

responsive.min1700: Increase hero top and lower spacing.
responsive.max1100: Reduce grid gaps and navigation spacing; hide hero barcode.
responsive.max760: Contact becomes one column; Toolkit follows the existing responsive inventory/detail layout.
responsive.max520: Mobile menu, one-column hero lower area and toolkit selector, stacked biography/contact, 23px gutters, simplified decorations.

implemented: Screen-reader h1 equivalent for SVG wordmark
Labeled terminal input and polite live output
Decorative geometry hidden from assistive technology
Decorative WebGL canvas hidden from assistive technology
Static reduced-motion field and unavailable-WebGL fallback
Toolkit pressed state and controlled detail relationship
Escape closes mobile menu and restores trigger focus
accessibility.verificationBoundary: Scoped Chromium checks and desktop/mobile review passed; not a formal accessibility certification or security audit.

contentConstraints: Preserve actual paid software experience, education, GitHub and professional contact channels.
No commercial Cyber Grotesk font files or copyrighted reference artwork.
Do not expose personal email or mailto links in rendered page content or terminal contact output.
Keep Toolkit about technologies only; do not imply an active Datashard showcase.
Ada Commerce is an educational Java 17 in-memory CLI, not a production storefront.
Plann.er is a local educational TypeScript/Fastify/SQLite API without frontend or authentication.
If preserved lab prototypes are surfaced later, retain synthetic-data, deterministic/local-retrieval, optional-LLM and demo-test limitations.
Build controls and scoped checks do not guarantee security or constitute formal audits.
